summary: Verified 2 bugfixes: (#1) score/pick JSON formatting via fmtPick/fmtResult on /bonus + Admin Gestione Bonus, and (#2) excluded fixtures propagate to Survival matchday. Both PASS on backend (pytest) and frontend (Playwright). Regression: admin+player login OK, /bonus renders, no crashes.
critical_code_review_comments: Minor: /app/backend/scoreandlive.py GET /api/sal/calendar defaults season to '2025-26' while stagione corrente è 2026-27; consider defaulting to current season env or making season required to avoid silent empty responses.
Minor: React hydration warning observed in console on Gestione Bonus page: '<span> cannot be a child of <option>' — non-blocking but should be fixed for cleanliness.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (both bugfixes visually confirmed + admin exclude flow)

seed_data_creation: None. Fixture Atalanta-Bologna G2 was temporarily excluded then RESTORED. Final API check confirms 10 fixtures present in Survival G2 (all teams intact).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Login endpoints return 'token' (NOT 'access_token'). Calendar endpoint requires season='2026-27' param (default is 2025-26). Bug#1 verified via UI: /bonus page (Survival tab) shows 'Risultato: 2-0' and picks like '1-1', '2-0', '3-1' with no JSON leaks; Admin Gestione Bonus card 'G1 Big Match' Roma-Fiorentina shows 'Risultato: 2-0'. Bug#2 verified via API: PATCH /api/sal/calendar/fixture/{id}/exclude {excluded:true} removes the fixture from GET /api/sv/tournaments/{tid}/matchdays/current fixtures array; restoring flips it back. Backend test file /app/backend/tests/test_bugfix_iter14.py covers both regression logins and the full exclude→verify→restore flow.
rca of the issue: N/A — bugs already fixed by main agent. Fix locations confirmed: /app/frontend/src/pages/Bonus.js (fmtPick/fmtResult), /app/frontend/src/components/admin/GestioneBonus.js (fmtResult), /app/backend/surviva.py (_matchday_dict filters excluded+postponed_before), /app/backend/scoreandlive.py (PATCH .../exclude propagates to sv_matchdays snapshots).
